criteria.requirement: Extend toc with opt-in unlisted_attribute="" (disabled default) and remove_unlisted_attribute=True. When enabled, presence of that exact heading attribute excludes only that heading from toc/toc_tokens, regardless of attribute value, preserving its real heading/id/body, anchor/permalink generation and descendant sections. Excluded parents do not prune child directory entries; surviving headings are nested by their real levels. Attribute removal is explicit and does not confuse data-toc-label or depth selection. Preserve default output and existing attr_list ordering, multiple markers, Unicode labels and reset behavior.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
